meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 vercel 命令行把网页应用部署到 Vercel:部署前先在本地跑一遍构建,部署后确认线上地址返回 2xx 才告诉你,顺带管理项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你要求把网页应用部署、发布或上线到 Vercel,或需要管理 Vercel 的项目、域名等时接管。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 以 --prod 部署,并回报线上地址

say.text: 帮我看下最近的部署列表
say.note: 运行 vercel ls 列出近期部署

say.text: 把 DATABASE_URL 加进 Vercel 的生产环境变量
say.note: 用 vercel env add 写入生产环境

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the vercel CLI to deploy web apps to Vercel: it runs the local build first, then confirms the live URL returns 2xx before telling you, and also manages projects, domains and env vars.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to deploy, ship or publish a web app to Vercel, or need to manage Vercel projects, domains, etc.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Deploys with --prod and reports the live URL
Runs vercel ls to list recent deployments

say_en.text: Add DATABASE_URL to Vercel's production env vars
say_en.note: Writes it via vercel env add
